journal.name: Tobin's Journal
journal.description: Twine-bound pages in Tobin's slanted hand. Some are written far too neatly to be his.

map.name: Map to Paradise
map.description: Hand-drawn on cloth. A dotted line runs south past the old bridge to a white smudge marked P.

shard.name: Humming Shard
shard.description: Dark stone, warm as skin. Its hum deepens whenever you face south.

medkit.name: Worn Medkit
medkit.description: A dented tin of bandages and bitter tonic. Packed long ago, as if someone expected you.

water.name: Water Flask
water.description: Clean water in a stoppered flask. Out here it tastes like home.

ration.name: Dry Ration
ration.description: Pressed grain and salt in waxed paper. Tastes of nothing, keeps forever.

core.name: Dormant Core
core.description: A fist-sized cell that pulses like a slow heart. Ryn swears it was stone-cold when he found it.

radio.name: Lullaby Radio
radio.description: Nova's cracked handset. It catches one station only: a lullaby she knows but can't place.

keycard.name: Blank Keycard
keycard.description: A thin grey card Eli never explains. Worn smooth except for two stamped numerals: 01.

toolkit.name: Salvage Toolkit
toolkit.description: Wrenches, wire and a cracked multimeter in an oilcloth roll. Ryn's, mostly.

crystal.name: Lattice Crystal
crystal.description: Mira's crystal, a fine grid etched inside. The grid rearranges itself, faster near your shard.

medallion.name: Iron Medallion
medallion.description: Kael's token on a frayed cord. He woke up wearing it and can't remember how he got it.
